prediction_rule: For every external sample, average the five frozen outer-model predictions first; compute metrics once on the ensemble vector.

definitions.mean mae: MAE of the five-model mean prediction vector
definitions.std mae: bootstrap standard deviation (standard error) of the ensemble MAE; 200,000 replicates
definitions.mean rmse: RMSE of the five-model mean prediction vector
definitions.max max_error: maximum absolute error of the five-model mean prediction vector
